summary: M12 background jobs now use the same cell-input bridge as foreground rlm_eval: a shared buildRlmCodeEvalInput factory supplies session: parent.session (sandbox policy identity), onQuery/onSpawn/onFollowup bridges, the per-cell token guard, and M8 continuable tracking (shared per-context set). createRlmJobSpec gained an optional options (preReserved/buildInput); startRlmJob reads runtime.runtimeConfig() and wraps the spec. A background job can execute await rlm_query and dispatch an official subagent.

pointers: Issue#78 job runs the same query bridge
Import surface (no semantic change in this commit)

steps: Verified: createRlmJobSpec.run() ran runtime.eval(key, { code, signal }) with no session/query bridge, so background cells could not use rlm_query and M9 policy resolved without the owner Session.
Extracted the tool execute input construction into buildRlmCodeEvalInput; registerRlmPlugin now shares continuableParentsFor(ctx) so job-spawned M8 children are drained on unload.

evidence.note: background cell returns bridged subagent text; input carries session + bridges

limitations: startRlmJob used without the plugin registered still creates M8 continuables that only DSH-level teardown can drain (no plugin unload hook).
